name: Labor Insurance (勞工保險)
authority: 勞工保險條例第13條、第15條第1款與勞工保險投保薪資分級表 — an 11.5% ordinary-risk premium borne 20% by the insured, 70% by the insured unit and 10% by the central government; the insured-salary grade table IS the band ladder below. Employment insurance is collected on the same ladder as the separate EI scheme, and the two together are the 12.5% combined premium the Bureau of Labor Insurance publishes. Cover ends at 65 (勞保條例第6條第1項 / 就業保險法第5條: 「年滿十五歲以上，六十五歲以下」), and that limit belongs on the SCHEME rather than on the bands. A band that simply has no row for an age refuses the whole run by name — so a single 65-year-old employee stopped every Taiwanese payroll — where a scheme the person is outside is skipped, producing no charge and no zero row. 職災保險 is deliberately unbounded: 災保法 covers a worker whatever their age, which is why it is a separate scheme. Each rule is the grade × rate × share, rounded once after the enrolled-day fraction (勞保條例施行細則 §28-1: 保險費每月以三十日計算; the Bureau's 114年 分擔金額表 is reproduced cell for cell, 1,680 of 1,680, by that arithmetic and by no rounding of the whole-month row first). Applied 2026-09-18: leave encashment (特休未休工資) does not re-declare the insured grade mid-year (投保薪資 and 月提繳工資 are declared on the ordinary wage), so ENCASHMENT is outside this base. Applied 2026-09-18: a part-time worker (`employment.type == "PART_TIME"`) is insured at the part-time grades below the floor (11,100 to 27,600; 勞保條例 §14, BLI Files/25659), the full-time ladder taking over above them. Applied 2026-09-18: a part-time worker (`employment.type == "PART_TIME"`) is insured at the part-time grades below the floor (11,100 to 27,600; 勞保條例 §14, BLI Files/25659), the full-time ladder taking over above them. Applied 2026-09-18 (4): 勞基法 §2(3): a recurring allowance is 工資 and enters the 投保薪資 / 月提繳工資 (`ALLOWANCES` and `ADHOC` (each class listing the scheme in its counts_toward) on the measured base, `terms.fixed_allowances` on the contractual one); a non-recurring bonus and severance are outside. Applied 2026-09-19 (2): The scheme is assessed on the insured amount itself (投保薪資 / 月提繳工資): the contractual monthly wage — basic and the recurring allowances, 勞基法 §2(3) — stepped up to its grade of the 分級表 (`ladder`), a part-timer on the part-time grades below the floor (勞保條例 §14; BLI Files/25659). The declared grade does not move with a month’s overtime, absence or one-off pay; it is re-declared when the contractual wage changes (§14(2), each February and August on the three-month average where the wage is not fixed). A scheme that reads `produced.<code>.base` therefore reads the graded insured amount. Applied 2026-09-19 (3): 勞保條例 §14(2) with 施行細則 §27: a worker whose wage is not fixed (`pay_frequency` DAILY / HOURLY / WEEKLY) is insured on the average of the three months before the February and August declarations — November to January from 1 March, May to July from 1 September (`earned_average("BASIC", …, 3)`, the window chosen from `period.month`); a fixed monthly wage is declared as it stands and re-declared when it changes. With no earlier payslip in the window the contract wage grades the month.

authority: 勞工退休金條例第14條第1項 — the employer shall contribute monthly to the worker's individual pension account no less than 6% of the worker's 月提繳工資, graded by the 勞工退休金月提繳分級表 (ceiling NT$150,000). The grade table IS the band ladder below. Each rule is the grade × rate × share, rounded once after the enrolled-day fraction (勞保條例施行細則 §28-1: 保險費每月以三十日計算; the Bureau's 114年 分擔金額表 is reproduced cell for cell, 1,680 of 1,680, by that arithmetic and by no rounding of the whole-month row first). Applied 2026-09-18: leave encashment (特休未休工資) does not re-declare the insured grade mid-year (投保薪資 and 月提繳工資 are declared on the ordinary wage), so ENCASHMENT is outside this base. Applied 2026-09-18: a part-time worker (`employment.type == "PART_TIME"`) is insured at the part-time grades below the floor (11,100 to 27,600; 勞保條例 §14, BLI Files/25659), the full-time ladder taking over above them. Applied 2026-09-18: 勞退條例 §14(3): the worker may contribute up to a further 6% of the grade (`voluntary_rate`, a percentage election), which §14(4) leaves out of the year’s taxable salary. Applied 2026-09-18: a part-time worker (`employment.type == "PART_TIME"`) is insured at the part-time grades below the floor (11,100 to 27,600; 勞保條例 §14, BLI Files/25659), the full-time ladder taking over above them. authority: 積欠工資墊償基金提繳及墊償管理辦法 §3 (勞基法 §28): the employer contributes 0.025% of the establishment’s aggregate insured-salary total each month, rounded once for the establishment; borne wholly by the employer. Read here over the sum of every payslip’s ordinary wage, the closest reading of the insured total. Applied 2026-09-18. Applied 2026-09-18 (4): 勞基法 §2(3): a recurring allowance is 工資 and enters the 投保薪資 / 月提繳工資 (`ALLOWANCES` and `ADHOC` (each class listing the scheme in its counts_toward) on the measured base, `terms.fixed_allowances` on the contractual one); a non-recurring bonus and severance are outside. Applied 2026-09-19 (2): 勞基法 §28(2): the fund is 0.025% of the insured salary total of the employer’s labour-insured workers (`produced.LI.base` over the run: the sum of the graded insured amounts), not of the wages paid.

name: Employment Insurance (就業保險)
authority: 就業保險法第8條、第40條與勞工保險條例第15條第1款 — a 1% employment-insurance premium on the same 投保薪資 ladder, borne 20% by the insured, 70% by the insured unit and 10% by the central government. 就業保險法第5條 limits cover to insured persons aged 15 to 65 who hold ROC nationality (or are a qualifying foreign spouse of a national), which is the age selector and the band predicate below. Cover ends at 65 (勞保條例第6條第1項 / 就業保險法第5條: 「年滿十五歲以上，六十五歲以下」), and that limit belongs on the SCHEME rather than on the bands. A band that simply has no row for an age refuses the whole run by name — so a single 65-year-old employee stopped every Taiwanese payroll — where a scheme the person is outside is skipped, producing no charge and no zero row. 職災保險 is deliberately unbounded: 災保法 covers a worker whatever their age, which is why it is a separate scheme. Each rule is the grade × rate × share, rounded once after the enrolled-day fraction (勞保條例施行細則 §28-1: 保險費每月以三十日計算; the Bureau's 114年 分擔金額表 is reproduced cell for cell, 1,680 of 1,680, by that arithmetic and by no rounding of the whole-month row first). Applied 2026-09-18: leave encashment (特休未休工資) does not re-declare the insured grade mid-year (投保薪資 and 月提繳工資 are declared on the ordinary wage), so ENCASHMENT is outside this base. Applied 2026-09-18: a part-time worker (`employment.type == "PART_TIME"`) is insured at the part-time grades below the floor (11,100 to 27,600; 勞保條例 §14, BLI Files/25659), the full-time ladder taking over above them. Applied 2026-09-18: a part-time worker (`employment.type == "PART_TIME"`) is insured at the part-time grades below the floor (11,100 to 27,600; 勞保條例 §14, BLI Files/25659), the full-time ladder taking over above them. Applied 2026-09-18 (4): 勞基法 §2(3): a recurring allowance is 工資 and enters the 投保薪資 / 月提繳工資 (`ALLOWANCES` and `ADHOC` (each class listing the scheme in its counts_toward) on the measured base, `terms.fixed_allowances` on the contractual one); a non-recurring bonus and severance are outside. Applied 2026-09-19 (2): The scheme is assessed on the insured amount itself (投保薪資 / 月提繳工資): the contractual monthly wage — basic and the recurring allowances, 勞基法 §2(3) — stepped up to its grade of the 分級表 (`ladder`), a part-timer on the part-time grades below the floor (勞保條例 §14; BLI Files/25659). The declared grade does not move with a month’s overtime, absence or one-off pay; it is re-declared when the contractual wage changes (§14(2), each February and August on the three-month average where the wage is not fixed). A scheme that reads `produced.<code>.base` therefore reads the graded insured amount. Applied 2026-09-19 (3): 勞保條例 §14(2) with 施行細則 §27: a worker whose wage is not fixed (`pay_frequency` DAILY / HOURLY / WEEKLY) is insured on the average of the three months before the February and August declarations — November to January from 1 March, May to July from 1 September (`earned_average("BASIC", …, 3)`, the window chosen from `period.month`); a fixed monthly wage is declared as it stands and re-declared when it changes. With no earlier payslip in the window the contract wage grades the month.

name: Labor Insurance (勞工保險)
authority: 勞工保險條例第13條、第15條第1款與勞工保險投保薪資分級表 — a 12% ordinary-risk premium borne 20% by the insured, 70% by the insured unit and 10% by the central government; the insured-salary grade table IS the band ladder below. From 1 January 2027 勞工保險條例第13條 steps the ordinary rate from 11.5% to 12%; the 116年 投保薪資分級表 will be re-issued from the 116年 minimum wage, so the ladder below still carries the 115年 grades. Employment insurance is collected on the same ladder as the separate EI scheme, and the two together are the 13% combined premium the Bureau of Labor Insurance publishes. Cover ends at 65 (勞保條例第6條第1項 / 就業保險法第5條: 「年滿十五歲以上，六十五歲以下」), and that limit belongs on the SCHEME rather than on the bands. A band that simply has no row for an age refuses the whole run by name — so a single 65-year-old employee stopped every Taiwanese payroll — where a scheme the person is outside is skipped, producing no charge and no zero row. 職災保險 is deliberately unbounded: 災保法 covers a worker whatever their age, which is why it is a separate scheme. Each rule is the grade × rate × share, rounded once after the enrolled-day fraction (勞保條例施行細則 §28-1: 保險費每月以三十日計算; the Bureau's 114年 分擔金額表 is reproduced cell for cell, 1,680 of 1,680, by that arithmetic and by no rounding of the whole-month row first). Applied 2026-09-18: leave encashment (特休未休工資) does not re-declare the insured grade mid-year (投保薪資 and 月提繳工資 are declared on the ordinary wage), so ENCASHMENT is outside this base. Applied 2026-09-18: a part-time worker (`employment.type == "PART_TIME"`) is insured at the part-time grades below the floor (11,100 to 27,600; 勞保條例 §14, BLI Files/25659), the full-time ladder taking over above them. Applied 2026-09-18: a part-time worker (`employment.type == "PART_TIME"`) is insured at the part-time grades below the floor (11,100 to 27,600; 勞保條例 §14, BLI Files/25659), the full-time ladder taking over above them. Applied 2026-09-18 (4): 勞基法 §2(3): a recurring allowance is 工資 and enters the 投保薪資 / 月提繳工資 (`ALLOWANCES` and `ADHOC` (each class listing the scheme in its counts_toward) on the measured base, `terms.fixed_allowances` on the contractual one); a non-recurring bonus and severance are outside. Applied 2026-09-19 (2): The scheme is assessed on the insured amount itself (投保薪資 / 月提繳工資): the contractual monthly wage — basic and the recurring allowances, 勞基法 §2(3) — stepped up to its grade of the 分級表 (`ladder`), a part-timer on the part-time grades below the floor (勞保條例 §14; BLI Files/25659). The declared grade does not move with a month’s overtime, absence or one-off pay; it is re-declared when the contractual wage changes (§14(2), each February and August on the three-month average where the wage is not fixed). A scheme that reads `produced.<code>.base` therefore reads the graded insured amount. Applied 2026-09-19 (3): 勞保條例 §14(2) with 施行細則 §27: a worker whose wage is not fixed (`pay_frequency` DAILY / HOURLY / WEEKLY) is insured on the average of the three months before the February and August declarations — November to January from 1 March, May to July from 1 September (`earned_average("BASIC", …, 3)`, the window chosen from `period.month`); a fixed monthly wage is declared as it stands and re-declared when it changes. With no earlier payslip in the window the contract wage grades the month.

name: Employment Insurance (就業保險)
authority: 就業保險法第8條、第40條與勞工保險條例第15條第1款 — a 1% employment-insurance premium on the same 投保薪資 ladder, borne 20% by the insured, 70% by the insured unit and 10% by the central government. 就業保險法第5條 limits cover to insured persons aged 15 to 65 who hold ROC nationality (or are a qualifying foreign spouse of a national), which is the age selector and the band predicate below. Cover ends at 65 (勞保條例第6條第1項 / 就業保險法第5條: 「年滿十五歲以上，六十五歲以下」), and that limit belongs on the SCHEME rather than on the bands. A band that simply has no row for an age refuses the whole run by name — so a single 65-year-old employee stopped every Taiwanese payroll — where a scheme the person is outside is skipped, producing no charge and no zero row. 職災保險 is deliberately unbounded: 災保法 covers a worker whatever their age, which is why it is a separate scheme. Each rule is the grade × rate × share, rounded once after the enrolled-day fraction (勞保條例施行細則 §28-1: 保險費每月以三十日計算; the Bureau's 114年 分擔金額表 is reproduced cell for cell, 1,680 of 1,680, by that arithmetic and by no rounding of the whole-month row first). Applied 2026-09-18: leave encashment (特休未休工資) does not re-declare the insured grade mid-year (投保薪資 and 月提繳工資 are declared on the ordinary wage), so ENCASHMENT is outside this base. Applied 2026-09-18: a part-time worker (`employment.type == "PART_TIME"`) is insured at the part-time grades below the floor (11,100 to 27,600; 勞保條例 §14, BLI Files/25659), the full-time ladder taking over above them. Applied 2026-09-18: a part-time worker (`employment.type == "PART_TIME"`) is insured at the part-time grades below the floor (11,100 to 27,600; 勞保條例 §14, BLI Files/25659), the full-time ladder taking over above them. Applied 2026-09-18 (4): 勞基法 §2(3): a recurring allowance is 工資 and enters the 投保薪資 / 月提繳工資 (`ALLOWANCES` and `ADHOC` (each class listing the scheme in its counts_toward) on the measured base, `terms.fixed_allowances` on the contractual one); a non-recurring bonus and severance are outside. Applied 2026-09-19 (2): The scheme is assessed on the insured amount itself (投保薪資 / 月提繳工資): the contractual monthly wage — basic and the recurring allowances, 勞基法 §2(3) — stepped up to its grade of the 分級表 (`ladder`), a part-timer on the part-time grades below the floor (勞保條例 §14; BLI Files/25659). The declared grade does not move with a month’s overtime, absence or one-off pay; it is re-declared when the contractual wage changes (§14(2), each February and August on the three-month average where the wage is not fixed). A scheme that reads `produced.<code>.base` therefore reads the graded insured amount. Applied 2026-09-19 (3): 勞保條例 §14(2) with 施行細則 §27: a worker whose wage is not fixed (`pay_frequency` DAILY / HOURLY / WEEKLY) is insured on the average of the three months before the February and August declarations — November to January from 1 March, May to July from 1 September (`earned_average("BASIC", …, 3)`, the window chosen from `period.month`); a fixed monthly wage is declared as it stands and re-declared when it changes. With no earlier payslip in the window the contract wage grades the month.
